menu.canvas.new_imp.note: Menu item that hatches a new Imp.

menu.canvas.show_hidden.note: Menu item that brings every hidden Imp back.

menu.canvas.settings.note: Menu item that opens the app-wide settings.

menu.imp.talk.note: Menu item that opens the Imp's message bubble.

menu.imp.settings.note: Menu item that opens the settings of one Imp.

menu.imp.let_out.note: Menu item (desktop only) that lets an Imp out onto the desktop.

menu.imp.send_home.note: Menu item (desktop only) that puts a free Imp back in the window.

menu.imp.call_home.note: Button: take back one of our Imps from the device that holds it.

menu.imp.call_home_ask.note: Menu item for an Imp away on another device: asks before calling it home.

menu.imp.hide.note: Menu item that hides an Imp. It then peeks out now and then.

menu.imp.copy_kit.note: Menu item that copies an Imp as a kit.

menu.imp.copy_link.note: Menu item that copies a link to an Imp's kit.

menu.imp.share.note: Menu item that shares an Imp.

menu.imp.goodbye.note: Menu item that says goodbye to an Imp for good. A dialog asks first.

menu.bar.imps.note: Menu bar button that opens the Imps' home window.

menu.bar.imps_help.note: Tooltip of the Imps button in the menu bar.

menu.bar.hide.note: Menu bar button that hides every Imp on the desktop.

menu.bar.show.note: Menu bar button that shows the hidden Imps again.

menu.bar.hide_help.en: Hide the Imps on your desktop
menu.bar.hide_help.zh-Hans: 隐藏桌面上的所有 Imp

menu.bar.none_out_help.note: Tooltip of the Hide button when no Imp is on the desktop.
menu.bar.none_out_help.en: No Imps are out on the desktop
menu.bar.none_out_help.es: Ningún Imp está en el escritorio

menu.bar.settings.note: Menu bar button that opens the settings for all Imps.

menu.bar.settings_help.note: Tooltip of the Settings button in the menu bar.
menu.bar.settings_help.zh-Hans: 所有 Imp 的设置项

menu.bar.quit.note: Menu bar button that quits the app.

menu.bar.state.out.note: State of an Imp that is on the desktop.

menu.bar.state.home.note: State of an Imp that is waiting in the app window.

menu.bar.state.hidden.note: State of an Imp that is hidden for now.

menu.imp.type.note: Button in an Imp's menu that opens the typing box.

menu.imp.talk_help.note: Tooltip of the Talk button in an Imp's menu.

menu.imp.type_help.note: Tooltip of the Type button in an Imp's menu.

menu.imp.talks.note: Tip and title of the button in an Imp's chat that opens what it said with other Imps.

menu.imp.send_to.note: Imp menu item that sends the Imp to visit a device. It comes back.

menu.imp.move_to.note: Imp menu item that moves the Imp to a Mac for good.

menu.imp.visit_tip.note: Tip on the Imp menu item that sends it to visit a device.
menu.imp.visit_tip.zh-Hans: {name} 去 {device} 做客，还可以回来。

menu.imp.move_tip.note: Tip on the Imp menu item that moves it to a Mac for good.

menu.imp.visit_none.note: Greyed Imp menu item when no other device is around.

menu.canvas.reset_background.note: File menu item: puts the plain background back (the Imps make the others).
